learnings_and_adjustments: Recent evaluations show a robust edge in heavily weighting platoon splits, driving our pivot toward teams with deep lineup flexibility. Conversely, predictive decay in heavily taxed bullpens has necessitated scaling down their reliance, focusing instead on strictly validated, rested relief corps to protect our models' late-game assumptions.
